result:
Lifetime earnings and the 30 ranks are in the game and on his PC: v37.21 is the main build, and v37.23 makes the Mainframe rank strip easier to read.

**What he will see**
- **The ranks:** there are 30, from scrounger i up to warlord v, set by lifetime earnings only. Spending never lowers his rank, and buying back a sale doesn't either.
- **The curve:** the first rank up comes at $20,000, about two good early raids. Each step needs about 6% more than the one before, and warlord v is at $1,500,000, about 120 raids or six weeks of regular play. I based this on his flight recorder of 11-01: when he gets out, his haul averages about $41,000, and about 1 run in 3 gets out, so roughly $12,500 a raid. These numbers are in DESIGN.md.
- **Rewards:** every rank pays once, either in $ ($2,500 rising to $25,000 at warlord v) or a kit of existing items (bandages, frags, medkits, plates, stims, smokes, decoys, data cores). The kind field is open so gear crates, dyes, relics and body options can be added later. A rank reward does not count toward lifetime earnings, so rewards can't push him up ranks by themselves.
- **The rank up line:** one short line on the floor, for example "rank up: scrounger iii  $2,500". If he ranks up away from the floor, the line waits until he is back.
- **On screen:** the Mainframe has a strip on every tab showing his rank, lifetime earnings, the next rank, its reward and a bar. The stats page has a "lifetime earnings" card with his rank under it. Nothing shows over heads in raids.
- **Saves:** an old save starts at the rank its lifetime earnings already reach, with those ranks marked as paid without paying them again. A brand-new account starts with $1,000.

**Checks**
- The new check failed on the build before and passed on the new one, and the seed 4242 fingerprint held.
- The first ship attempt stopped because the market (v37.20) landed first and changes the price after each sale. I fixed the check to use the amount the sale actually paid, and it shipped.
- The critic gave the Mainframe and stats screens 3, which is his finish line for those screens. I fixed its notes on small labels and too much lime in v37.23. I skipped its suggestion to remove lifetime earnings from the strip and card, because the job requires both.

**Not done:** there is no picture of the rank up line, because none of the 78 screens shows a rank up. I asked in questions.md whether one can be added; the check proves the line appears.

**What he should watch for:** whether $20,000 for the first rank feels fast enough. His own save will start at a high rank because it already has a lot of lifetime earnings. The new strip also pushes the contracts list down about 90px.

This ends m1, so the season zero lead can ask him for a playtest. Logged in notes/progression/log.md, notes/ui/changes.md and notes/00p-m1e-ranks.md.

TASK DONE
